text:
nina: Flagging an onboarding noise pattern we hit on mobile + web: parallel imports across tabs/workers cause synchronized retries and duplicated embed work. different from pure fanout: the service-worker + background sync causes cross-tab replays.
sam: ouch. cross-tab + service-worker can reissue inflight requests after a crash, and SDK per-process inflight caps don't coordinate.
luc: paste of headers we saw: 
```
POST /v1/embeds/batch 290ms
<- 429 Retry-After: 1
<- X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
<- body: {"code":"rate_limit","detail":"burst"}
```
luc: tabs then all retry after 1s and we get duplicate accepts.
maya: couple of options: (1) introduce a lightweight cross-tab semaphore using BroadcastChannel/localStorage so browser tabs share a maxInFlightPerSession; (2) emit an idempotency/session token per batch so server can dedupe accepts and avoid billing dupes; (3) server could return X-Queue-Token which clients use to stagger retries.
nina: agree. idempotency token helps billing but still wastes compute if server can't dedupe mid-flight. cross-tab semaphore prevents the hammer. sampleapp should ship a tiny helper util for both approaches.
sam: mobile note: on Android background services the RNG for jitter was weak after sleep cycles, causing near-zero jitter and aligned retries. we'll add entropy check and fallback to secure RNG.
luc: SDK additions: - maxInFlightPerSession (config) - cross-process adapter hook (optional) - idempotency token helper for batch ops. default maxInFlightPerSession=3 for onboarding templates.
maya: server: consider accepting Idempotency-Key and store short TTL to dedupe rapid retries. also optional header X-Queue-Advice: {pos:7,factor:1.6} (advisory) would be useful.
ci-bot: New issue created: INF-4999 "cross-tab/session dedupe + idempotency for onboarding" assigned to @sam @luc @maya :white_check_mark:
nina: i'll add a tiny cross-tab semaphore util in sampleapps repo and a walkthrough in onboarding docs. will also update mobile examples to use secure RNG for jitter.
sam: i'll implement idempotency-key handling in the rate pipeline and a short TTL dedupe table. luc: pls coordinate SDK flags.
luc: will add config and small e2e that runs 6 tabs + 4 mobile workers to assert duplicates <1.2x. timeline: one sprint for sampleapp util + mobile RNG fix, server dedupe + SDK flags next sprint.
maya: also add SDK telemetry metric "session_duplicate_retries" to detect regressions.
nina: thanks folks. linking PRs here when ready. :thumbsup:
